title: Price one odd root pair at copy rank 7
body:
## Summary
- The doubled roots `(2, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)` and `(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)` have inner product 1. Their label pairing on the other 118 lines has rank 7. Restoring either line, or pairing the first line with itself, raises that rank to 8.
- Eight rank-7 children, with the centre charge lowered from 64 to 56, have packing ceiling `2069881607/1000000000000`. The ratio to the selected ceiling is `26201033/21393090`, above `21/20`.
- Centre reads, phase frames and restoration stay unpriced. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
